xmldoc.short_description: Graphics object whose callback is running.

param_output_item.param_description: a graphics object: the object whose callback is running, or [] when no callback is running.
a graphics object: the figure that contains h, or [] when no callback is running.

description.p: h = gcbo() returns the graphics object that owns the callback being executed, for example the push button whose Callback or CreateFcn is running.
When callbacks are nested, the object of the innermost one is returned.
Outside a callback, or when the object has been deleted in the meantime, h and fig are both empty ([]).

[h, fig] = gcbo() also returns the figure that contains the object. When the object is a figure, fig is that figure. When the object is not inside a figure, fig is the current figure (a figure is created if none exists).
It is useful when the same callback function is shared by several objects and must know which one triggered it.

example_item.example_item_description: The callback reads the object that called it.
One callback shared by two buttons (click a button).
